items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.excerpt:
[ UI ]

Demo/Replay viewer improvements:
• Added a progress bar for demo/replay downloads
• Camera controls now use click-and-drag scheme
• Free and chase camera are usable during a paused demo
• Fixed some minor issues when seeking to a different position in the demo file

• Added a ping icon for dropped defuse kits
• Reduced the time for AUG reload by half second
• Fixed the sound event during silent reload for Desert Eagle
• Fixed a case of buzzing soundscape sounds during demo playback
• Clipping fixes for Rush maps
